name: plain-s1-holdout2-r2-answer_shipping_zone_count-amplifier-plain-a1
final_message:
I read every file in the directory. `shipping.ZONES` (the authoritative source per README and the module docstring) defines these keys:

```
NA-EAST, NA-WEST, EU-CENTRAL, EU-NORTH, APAC-SE
```

The other files don't add to the count:
- `decoy_legacy_zones.py` — deprecated `LEGACY_ZONES` (ZONE-A..D), explicitly not current
- `decoy_partner_regions.py` — partner `REGIONS` list, not zone codes
- `decoy_warehouse_map.py` — `WAREHOUSE_ZONE` values reference 3 of the real codes but is not `shipping.ZONES`
- `checkout.py`, `notify.py` — no zone definitions

ANSWER: 5
